programs.name: adaptive_lag_drift
programs.description: Use when the sampling label does not reveal the true cycle length and recent values repeat at an empirically detectable lag with gradual level drift.
programs.assumption: Within the last 76 observations, some lag from 2 to 90 has walk-forward mean sMAPE at least 10% below a trailing-median forecast, and its lag differences have a stable median.
programs.failure_condition: It fails when no candidate lag beats the trailing-median benchmark by 10%, or when the selected lag's future differences depart materially from their recent median.

programs.name: phasewise_cycle_regression
programs.description: Use when a repeating cycle is present but different positions in the cycle have distinct trends, such as recurring high and low blocks whose levels rise at different rates.
programs.assumption: A lag between 2 and 90 yields at least a 12% walk-forward sMAPE improvement over a recent-median forecast, and at least two recent same-phase cycle differences are available for most phases.
programs.failure_condition: It fails if the cycle phase shifts, fewer than two comparable cycles remain in the current regime, or phase-specific increments reverse after the forecast origin.
